title: CaliberCos Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: CaliberCos Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a note conversion program launched in March 2026, whereby holders of unsecured promissory notes may elect to convert outstanding debt into shares of Class A Common Stock or Series AAA Convertible Preferred Stock. As of April 9, 2026, note holders had converted $3,450,271 of outstanding indebtedness, consisting of $1,921,771 in Notes exchanged for 1,707,900 shares of Class A Common Stock and $1,528,500 in Notes exchanged for 1,529 shares of Series AAA Preferred Stock. The company also amended its Series A Convertible Preferred Stock terms to rank pari passu with Series AAA Preferred Stock.
key_points: CaliberCos launched a note conversion program in March 2026 allowing note holders to convert unsecured promissory notes into equity.
$3,450,271 total outstanding indebtedness converted as of April 9, 2026.
$1,921,771 of Notes converted into 1,707,900 shares of Class A Common Stock.
$1,528,500 of Notes converted into 1,529 shares of Series AAA Preferred Stock.
Series A Convertible Preferred Stock amended to rank pari passu with Series AAA Preferred Stock.
Shares issued were not registered under the Securities Act and constitute restricted securities.
